Developing growth strategies and plans

Riot Sydney is looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Sydney-based League, gameplay team. 

As Software Engineers at Riot, we bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas and also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. We work with both new and current technology, creating innovative solutions to overcome high-volume obstacles and to deliver player value.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Game team under League’s Gameplay initiative, you will bring deep gameplay technical knowledge and skills to the game play domains in League of Legends. You will increase sustainability for new/existing game modes and develop tools and workflows that make it easier for designers and artists to create awesome experiences for our players. You will work as part of a diverse team consisting of artists, designers, engineers, producers, and QA. You will contribute to technical decision-making processes, driving team-level decisions in alignment with product goals. You will report to the Team Engineering Manager.

This is a full-time role, based in Sydney, Australia. Internal Job Title: Software Engineer II. 

Responsibilities:
Develop and implement improvements to help League of Legends maintain and scale game modes more sustainably.
Understand backend services powering League of Legends and collaborate with the team to use them effectively.
Automate aspects of creating and running new and existing game modes.
Design and develop features and UI in the League of Legends game engine using C++.
Work closely with cross-disciplinary teams in Sydney and the US (Game Designers, Artists, Animators, Quality, and Producers) to shape engaging player experiences.
Provide feedback to designers and artists on technical tradeoffs of their designs and ideas.
Participate in team technical decisions and contribute to the overall product direction.
Mentor and support less experienced engineers.
Participate in team's on-call rotation where you may be required to be on-call during certain periods outside of your normal working hours

Required Qualifications: 
4+ yrs of collective professional experience building applications or games in a client-server architecture.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or comparable field or equivalent experience
Experience working closely with non-engineering collaborators to deliver value
Experience building games
Experience working with complex code bases
Professional experience using C++

For this role, you'll succeed through craft expertise and a collaborative spirit that prioritises the delight of players. We will look at your past studies and experience, but for this role, we also look for dedicated people with a personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this is the role for you!
result.title: Senior Software Engineer, Gameplay - League of Legends

A premier medical facility in the coastal enclave of Dawesville is seeking a dedicated  Registered or Enrolled Nurse  to join their clinical team. The practice offers a warm and professional environment, characterized by a modern facility designed to support a high standard of patient care. Operating as a comprehensive primary care hub, the clinic features well-equipped treatment rooms and advanced diagnostic tools, providing a seamless workspace for clinicians who value efficiency and quality. 

 The team composition fosters a collaborative atmosphere, where nurses work alongside a diverse group of General Practitioners and a proactive administrative team. Significant support is provided through a structured  Chronic Disease Management (CDM)  framework, ensuring that the nursing staff can effectively manage care plans and health assessments with the backing of experienced colleagues. The practice utilizes a balanced billing model that prioritizes patient accessibility while maintaining a sustainable and rewarding professional environment. 

 Clinical autonomy is a core tenet of this role, allowing the successful candidate to oversee the daily coordination of the treatment room, manage stock control, and lead infection control protocols. Beyond routine wound care and immunizations, there are ample opportunities to explore  special interest areas  and assist with minor surgical procedures. For those looking to progress their careers, the practice provides robust  CPD support  and clear pathways for  supervisor opportunities , encouraging staff to mentor peers and refine their clinical leadership skills. 

 Recognizing the importance of work-life integration, the position offers a desirable  Monday to Friday (9:00 am – 5:00 pm)  roster, providing true flexibility and no weekend requirements. The location itself offers exceptional lifestyle benefits; situated in the picturesque Peel region, the clinic is moments away from pristine beaches and the Harvey Estuary, making it an ideal setting for those who enjoy an active, coastal lifestyle. This is a rare opportunity to secure a stable career move in a supportive environment that truly invests in the professional growth of its nursing team.   Apply Now

Project Engineer – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $100,000 – $140,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Project Engineer to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Project Engineer, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering engineering projects across mining, oil and gas, and industrial sectors. You will work closely with project managers, clients, engineers, supervisors, and site personnel to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual and engineering requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Plan, coordinate, and manage engineering projects from commencement through to completion.
•	Review engineering drawings, specifications, contracts, and project documentation.
•	Prepare project schedules, work programs, budgets, cost estimates, and resource plans.
•	Coordinate engineering, fabrication, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.
•	Monitor project progress and ensure milestones, budgets, and quality standards are achieved.
•	Liaise with clients, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal project teams.
•	Identify technical issues and provide practical engineering solutions to minimise project risks.
•	Ensure compliance with Australian Standards, engineering specifications, contractual obligations, and company procedures.
•	Prepare technical reports, progress reports, project documentation, and engineering correspondence.
•	Assist with tender preparation, cost planning, and contract administration.
•	Conduct site inspections and support project delivery teams to ensure safe and efficient execution of works.
•	Promote and maintain compliance with workplace health, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, Structural, or related discipline).
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as a Project Engineer or in a similar engineering role.
•	Experience delivering mining, industrial, fabrication, maintenance, shutdown, or construction projects.
•	Strong knowledge of project planning, engineering principles, contract administration, and project delivery.
•	Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
•	Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organisational skills.
•	Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced project environment.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $100,000 – $140,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing professional development and career progression.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

General Clerk (Permanent Full-Time)

Company: DR Brothers Pty Ltd

Trading Name: Tucker Box Motor Inn

Location: 87–97 Mount Street, Gundagai NSW 2722
Salary: $70,000–$80,000 per year (depending on skills and experience)

About Us

DR Brothers Pty Ltd, trading as Tucker Box Motor Inn, is seeking a reliable and organised General Clerk to join our friendly team on a permanent full-time basis. This role is ideal for someone with strong administrative skills, excellent customer service, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities
Perform a wide range of administrative and clerical duties.
Record, prepare, sort, classify, and file documents and information.
Answer telephone calls, emails, and guest enquiries professionally.
Manage guest bookings, reservations, and customer records.
Record the issue of equipment to staff.
Sort, open, and distribute incoming mail, and prepare outgoing mail.
Photocopy, scan, and prepare routine documents and reports.
Receive and relay telephone messages and correspondence.
Enter, update, proofread, and maintain accurate computer records.
Provide guests with information about motel services and local attractions.
Process payments and maintain accurate financial records.
Maintain organised office filing systems and administrative records.
Assist with guest check-in and check-out when required.
Liaise with housekeeping and maintenance teams to support smooth daily operations.
Monitor and order office supplies.
Provide administrative support to motel management.
Perform reception duties as required.
